title: Conventions for cross-team flag management commands and Temporal health checks
answers: How should a management command iterate all teams' flags?
How do I add a Temporal health check for feature flags?
Why not .iterator() in flag audit command?
body:
Management commands (`management/commands/audit_flag_filters.py`, `repair_replay_linked_flag_keys.py`):
- Read-only/offline by default; `--limit` (0=all, negative -> CommandError), `--team-id` (nonexistent -> CommandError), `--json`.
- `_iter_flag_rows` uses keyset pagination (`id__gt`, chunk 500), NOT `.iterator()` (PgBouncer, server-side cursors disabled).
- Bounded output: `MAX_TRACKED_UNKNOWN_KEYS`, capped samples, `_sanitize_for_console` for user JSON. Frozen dataclasses + outcome enums.
- repair command counts unsafe rows (soft-deleted/other-project) and skips them; rewrites under team row lock.
Temporal health checks (`posthog/temporal/health_checks/README.md`, example `StaleFeatureFlagsCheck`):
- Subclass `HealthCheck` with `name`, globally unique `kind`, `owner=JobOwners.TEAM_FEATURE_FLAGS`; register module in `HEALTH_CHECK_MODULES` in `registry.py`.
- `detect(team_ids)` gets a batch, returns dict[team_id, list[HealthCheckResult]]; absent teams = healthy (issues auto-resolve). Filter queries by `team_id__in=team_ids`.
applies: Jobs iterating over all teams in products/feature_flags; no AGENTS.md exists there.
